notes: Web 437 — COUNT-SITE-CONFIRM-WIDEZONE (Nov 12, 2026; layers on web 436). The owner's order, Nov 12 ~13:46 CST: “The app should know if the user is not working on site... The GPS peg for the dump site should be big enough to accommodate any missteps automatically. The tricky part is for the app to know if the user is working on site... But I think that can be confirmed if the pegs are both close by.” THE FIX (js/geoloads.js only): (1) SITE CONFIRMATION BY PAIR PROXIMITY — when the day's pickup and dump points (the pegged pegs, the dispatch-given pair, or a learned pair) fit inside the site's own believed scale — the dump seed's profile scale: the land-use prior or the learned scale, whichever runs further (work 1200 m / unknown 450 m / residential 300 m at first arm) — the site is CONFIRMED working ground for the day. Judged fresh at every arm, so a re-peg or a dispatch change re-decides it; the count banks across re-arms as always, and a pair beyond the scale is NOT confirmed and widens nothing. (2) A GENEROUS ZONE FROM THE START, on a confirmed site only: the dump-visit counter gains zone candidates that judge arrival and close over the reach the profile already believes (floored at the house 450 m shadow reach) instead of waiting for proven faces to grow it — the FIRST tip of the day at a face moved tens to a few hundred metres counts by GPS, no +1 needed. (3) SEPARATION BY SEQUENCE inside the one site: which end a stop belongs to is decided by decisive proximity (nearer that end by more than the peg law's 10 m tie band; the lens between the ends belongs to neither, so a mid-site washroom stop can neither count a tip nor close a visit); an arrival still lands through the one shared landing, so a visit can never count twice; a face the zone proves joins the site like any machine-proven face; and a confirmed load-end close also clears dump presence — on one ground the load end sits inside the dump's presence web, so a departure judged from the dump points alone could never fire while he loads, and the stuck presence swallowed the next arrival whole. (4) On a both-pegs day the same confirmation widens the peg counter's fence-recovery adoption: a stop cluster decisively the waiting end's, inside the one site, adopts its centre onto the face in one step instead of spending a short tip walking 25 m a dwell (the count still lands through the ordinary fence dwell from the adopted centre; the beyond-band adoption and the equidistant-stop refusal are unchanged). UNTOUCHED: the 436 +1 teaching, the honest GPS/tap split, same-place handling, micro-pair days, and every unconfirmed day's behaviour — a far-apart pair (the Aecon pair, 2075 m) runs exactly web 436: the moved face still needs the first +1 teach, then counts.
